title: Safety: short circuits
summary: See the app block a dangerous wire.

steps.text: A short circuit is a wire from a power pin straight to ground. Current rushes through with nothing to slow it down, and that can damage the Pico or your USB port.
Let's watch the app stop one. Click hole 5j (next to 3V3, pin 36), then hole 3j (next to GND, pin 38).

expect.success: Blocked! Every wire is checked before it can appear in a build step, so a short like this never reaches your instructions.
